name: ai-resume-analyzer-workspace
description: AI Resume & ATS Analyzer workspace with single-command development startup

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "server,client" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix ai-resume-analyzer/server run dev" "npm --prefix ai-resume-analyzer/client run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix ai-resume-analyzer/server install && npm --prefix ai-resume-analyzer/client install
